_comment: Copy this file to zconfig.json and fill in your values. zconfig.json is gitignored — never commit it.

projects._comment: Rename these keys to your own project names — the key IS the command argument: zstart pyapp, zdeploy viteapp, zbackup nextapp. Add as many projects as you like. Keys starting with _ are ignored.

pyapp.label: My Python App
pyapp._startApp_note: ASGI/FastAPI app? Use "startApp": "app.main:app" instead of startModule (runs uvicorn --port <dev> --reload).

start._comment: Optional zstart pre-steps: gitPull runs 'git pull --ff-only' first; env sets variables for the server process.

verify._comment: Optional: after deploy, curl this ON the server (localhost:port+path) and require the substring. The accurate check for apps not published through the edge proxy.

deploy._comment: preserve: server-side files/dirs in the project dir that deploys must never delete (.env* files are always preserved)

verify._comment: Optional: after deploy, curl this ON the server (localhost:port+path). Add it when compose publishes the app to 127.0.0.1 only, as it usually does behind the edge proxy — probing the public IP on that port can never answer. Redirects are followed, so a Next.js '/' that 307s to '/login' still verifies. Takes precedence over the domain check.
